# Project Maya — Technical Summary

## What it is
Project Maya is a free, open-source local inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) that runs on consumer hardware by tiering memory: VRAM expert cache → pinned RAM → NVMe SSD, with a browser dashboard and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs.

## Models & quants
- **Maya-S / Maya-L**: custom ~2-bit and ~3.5-bit quants of GLM-5.3
